Instead, the agent tried multiple incorrect lead IDs (123, 456, 789, etc.), resulting in repeated 404 errors indicating 'Lead not found'. The database diff shows no changes were made, confirming the task was not completed. The environment review explicitly states this was an agent failure due to incorrect data lookup rather than a server issue.
